title: Hierarchical nanoporous NiCoN nanoflowers with highly rough surface electrode material for high-performance asymmetric supercapacitors
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,4619-4627
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07757A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mohan Reddy Pallavolu, Chandu V. V. Muralee Gopi, Samikannu Prabu, Punna Reddy Ullapu, Jae Hak Jung, Sang Woo Joo, R. Ramesh
NiCoN nanoflowers, synthesized via a hydrothermal method, exhibit superior electrochemical performance as positive electrode material for asymmetric supercapacitors, offering high energy density, excellent rate capability, and cycling stability.
